gaps: P0: nothing; P2: nothing usable; P5: nothing
notes: #3, #4, #6, #7 are other copies of the same Braun and Hogenberg plate (open-book photos or the 1612/1645 reprints); #8 is the text verso. #9 (about 1650) is an allegory of Louis XIII with only a small background view of the town. #11 is a smaller copy of #10. #1, #2 are John Everett paintings dated only late 19th to mid 20th century (the 1394/1406 in the title are museum numbers). #13’s Commons artist “AM Jhot” looks like the uploader, so credited as unknown photographer. #17 (Signac) is dated only 1911–1922. #12 photochrom shows just the Hôtel de Ville. P6 uses a 1970s aerial; #19 (2006 night panorama of the towers) is the alternative if a more recent view is preferred, but it is very wide and dark.
